instruction: A candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the man in the black shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, watching the action. On the right, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) balances on her left leg, executing a high kick with her right leg towards the man's upper body. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the entire scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
